item.title: Bioinformatics without R is like Jai without Veeru
item.description:
Hi! I’m an online educator with a strong background in computer science, now helping biotech and life sciences students learn programming intuitively — rooted in the true origins and history of computing, not just for jobs or certifications.
DM me if you’re ready to explore programming the right way!
